_comment: Published proof figures. Updated by the loop when a measurement window closes.

design._comment: What kind of claim the numbers on this page can support. Every surface that describes the method or renders a result must read this rather than hard-coding prose — a page that says 'we split pages at random' while nothing does is a false claim on the page we point at as proof.
design.note: No holdout is running on this domain. The site is 31 pages and the loop does not yet split them into treated and untouched groups, so a difference between the two cannot be reported. Results here are before-and-after, which cannot separate our work from the season.

notes: Baseline captured before any Autopilot change shipped. Source: Google Search Console, domain property, final data state.
